notes:
Summary: Verdane SpeedWorks is an adtech DSP working on sub-30ms reranking for real-time bidding. Highly cost-sensitive; target cost-per-request ~ $0.0004-$0.0007. Interested in Redwood Dedicated + Optimize recommendations (batching, prefix/KV caching, int8 quantization) to hit SLOs and unit-economics.

Call highlights: 
- 2025-11-16 intro: Jordan/Kim demo; interested in hosted-to-dedicated migration.
- Quote from CTO: "We need consistent p95 under 30ms across 2 regions or we lose auctions."
- Perf ask: benchmark quantized 7b model vs FP16 on H100/A10 equiv, include warm-cache vs cold-cache numbers.
- Workload shape: many short contexts (30-80 tokens), heavy reuse of common prefixes (ad templates), bursts up to 20k req/s for peak auctions.
- Cost levers discussed: sub-token batching for similar prefixes, KV/prefix caching to avoid repeated KV expansion, int8/4-bit quantization to lower GPU footprint.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS, and EU data residency for bidders in EU.

POC plan (agreed): 3-week POC -> week1 integration + security review, week2 perf runs (cold/warm), week3 tuning + canary in dedicated. Redwood to provide perf harness and baseline scripts.

Requested artifacts: pricing deck, security FAQ, sample perf harness config, example rollout policy template.

Sales note: high intent on cost optimization; procurement Q2 looks likely if p95 targets validated. SE to run quantization bench and produce cost/latency tradeoff matrix.
